name: folio
description: Magazine-style presentation skill that turns structured content into editable decks across HTML, PPTX, PDF, Figma, and IDML.
release_highlights: Added Text Layout QA for dense, table, bilingual, and long-deck slides.
Added severity rules for clipped text, shrink-to-fit, footer collisions, and overlong CJK/Latin lines.
Clarified that package integrity and font policy checks must be paired with visual/text-box review before claiming completion.
